text:
Thornbury Press has bought the rights to *The Glass Cartographer*, the publisher announced on 14 March 2025.

The acquisition was confirmed in a joint press statement issued with the publisher's author's literary agency at the Halvorsen Book Fair. The Continental Record has reviewed the signed rights agreement released alongside that statement.

According to the agreed deal terms set out in the document, Thornbury Press will pay £420,000 for world English-language rights.

Marguerite Ellsworth-Vane, acquisitions director at Thornbury Press, led the negotiations on the publisher's behalf. The agreement was signed by Thornbury Press and the author's literary agency, and both parties endorsed the joint statement.

The documents released at the fair do not describe further terms beyond the rights and the price. Neither party has indicated that any other publisher was party to the agreement.
